blocks.h2: Gas Fireplace Questions From Hinsdale Homeowners

items.q: Can our wood-burning fireplace be converted to gas?
items.preview: Often, if the chimney is sound.
items.answer: Often. The chimney has to be in good shape and drawing well. We run the gas line and install the valve, and a chimney specialist handles any flue work.

items.q: Does a gas log fireplace need the damper open?
items.preview: Yes, vented logs need it held open.
items.answer: Yes. Vented gas logs need a fixed damper opening so exhaust can leave through the chimney. A damper clamp prevents it from being closed.

items.q: Why won't my pilot stay lit?
items.preview: Usually a dirty pilot or a weak thermocouple.
items.answer: Usually the pilot is dirty or the thermocouple or thermopile is weak. Cleaning or replacing the part fixes it.
September or early October, before the first cold night.
